Best 2000Wh solar generator kits with solar panels (2026)

For a 2,000Wh (2kWh) portable solar generator kit, I'd prioritize EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery, and Anker.

The best setup should include a LiFePO4 battery, at least 2,000W of AC output, and ideally 400W or more of solar panels. A 200W panel works, but charging a 2kWh battery from sunlight alone can take a long time.

One important distinction: a 2,000Wh battery stores approximately 2kWh of energy, while a 2,000W inverter determines how much power you can draw at once. For appliances, both specifications matter.
